audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content.win[0-5] read 'Blitzcrank' and win[6] reads 'Milio' — and packet.levelChart (Blitzcrank x6, Milio x1) matches win[]. The full-layer chart disagrees with the content-layer chart and the packet on every single row.
audit.why: The level chart is the single most load-bearing visual on the page; a reader sees it say 'even' on every row while the prose text elsewhere (whys[], early, spikes) all describe Blitzcrank dominating lane.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0-5].side to Blitzcrank and phases[6].side to Milio to match win[]/packet, and rewrote each phases[N].why (previously generic template text identical across matchups) to ground the verdict in this matchup's actual mechanics — Rocket Grab's threat range/cooldown, the lack of a Milio dash/cleanse for hooks, and the level-6/2-item flip once Breath of Life can answer the follow-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says 'Your Q heal and cleanse can't undo a displacement.' Milio's Q has no heal or cleanse — that's his R, Breath of Life.
audit.why: Same fabricated-mechanic pattern as other Milio matchups: attributing the R's heal/cleanse to Q would mislead a reader about what's actually on cooldown when.
audit.corrected: Changed 'Your Q heal and cleanse' to 'Your R heal and cleanse'.
sources: ownerKit Q/R ability text in brief

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit. Also flagged by packet.defects: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.'
audit.why: Both point at the same gap — the field needs a real, punishable cooldown number.
audit.corrected: Added Rocket Grab's real cooldown (20s rank 1, 16s maxed).
